001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.clafer.common.Check;
005import org.clafer.common.Util;
006
007/**
008 * foldl1 op operands. Note that even implies is left-associative.
009 *
010 * @author jimmy
011 */
012public record AstBoolArithm(Op op, AstBoolExpr[] operands) implements AstBoolExpr {
013
014    public AstBoolArithm {
015        op = Check.notNull(op);
016        operands = Check.noNullsNotEmpty(operands);
017    }
018
019    @Override
020    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
021        return obj instanceof AstBoolArithm other
022                && op == other.op && Arrays.equals(operands, other.operands);
023    }
024
025    @Override
026    public int hashCode() {
027        // op.hashCode() can change between runs which makes the output change
028        // every time.
029        return op.ordinal() ^ Arrays.hashCode(operands);
030    }
031
032    @Override
033    public String toString() {
034        return "(" + Util.intercalate(") " + op.getSyntax() + " (", operands) + ")";
035    }
036
037    public static enum Op {
038
039        And("&&"),
040        IfOnlyIf("<=>"),
041        Implies("=>"),
042        Or("||"),
043        Xor("xor");
044        private final String syntax;
045
046        private Op(String syntax) {
047            this.syntax = syntax;
048        }
049
050        public String getSyntax() {
051            return syntax;
052        }
053    }
054}
